NOON REPORT - MV TORMAR SPRING
Date/time: 24 Jan 2025 1200 (ship's time UTC)

Next port: Sept-Iles
ETA Sept-Iles: 2025-01-31 0300 UTC
ETA based on: 12.5 kn
Remarks: Heavy weather, strong head wind and very high head sea. Speed reduced for safety.

Master MV TORMAR SPRING

Please review the ETA for Sept-Iles in view of the forecast.

Reference noon report nr-0104.

Best regards,
